{
  "name": "todo-bar",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "The task list's progress in a band above the prompt, read from the todo and task tools' own calls: no tool, no prompt, no tokens",
  "author": {
    "name": "hoobnn",
    "url": "https://github.com/hoobnn"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "repository": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "todo",
    "tasks",
    "progress",
    "band",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "visible": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the band",
      "description": "Show the progress band; /todos off and /todos on set this too",
      "default": true
    },
    "showNext": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show what comes next",
      "description": "A dim second row with the next one or two tasks",
      "default": true
    },
    "showAgents": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show running subagents",
      "description": "A row under the running task for each subagent still at work: its task, the tool it is on and how long it has run",
      "default": true
    },
    "slowMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Slow task (minutes)",
      "description": "The running task's time turns yellow once it has run this many minutes; 0 never",
      "default": 10
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the band and /todos; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh-Hans",
        "zh-Hant",
        "ja",
        "ko",
        "es",
        "fr",
        "de",
        "pt-BR",
        "ru"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
